tasks.name: The Right Option tap switches; Ctrl+Shift+B goes
tasks.description: shift_tap takes a tap descriptor; the processor switches the backend on a lone Right Option tap; decide no longer returns switch_backend.
acceptance: A Right Option press and release within 500 ms, alone, switches the backend in every phase, with or without a draft, and commits nothing
Left Option, a hold of 500 ms or more, Option with another key or with Shift, Control or Command, and Ctrl+Shift+B switch nothing
The Shift tap behaves exactly as before
